category.instructions: Which kind of bug is this? It selects the specialist agents that investigate it.

criteria.simple_ui: A visual or layout defect in one component, no data or state involved
criteria.api_backend: A request, response, contract, status code or auth problem
criteria.state: Client state is wrong, stale, or out of sync between components
criteria.ssr_hydration: Server and client render differently, or a hydration mismatch
criteria.performance: It works but is slow, janky, or does too much work
criteria.typescript: A type error, an inference failure, or a signature mismatch
criteria.accessibility: Keyboard, screen reader, focus order, or contrast
criteria.intermittent: It fails only sometimes, or under timing or load
criteria.unknown: The report does not identify the area well enough to place it
criteria.critical: Production is down, data is being lost, or auth can be bypassed

severity.instructions: How much is broken, and for how many people?
criteria: Cosmetic or a minor annoyance, nobody is blocked
A feature is broken for some users or in some conditions
A feature is broken for every user
Production is down, data is being lost, or auth can be bypassed

complexity.instructions: How much work is the fix, given what the report says?
criteria: One file, a clear error, a known pattern. Fix it inline
Two or three files with a root cause that diagnosis will reach
Architectural or spanning three or more concerns, or three fixes already failed

context.instructions: What situation is this bug being worked in? It selects how the work closes.

criteria.standalone: A reported bug, not part of feature work in progress
criteria.during_feature: Found while building something else, not its own ticket
criteria.production_incident: Broken in production right now, with urgency

needs_repro.instructions: Must this be reproduced before it can be diagnosed?

criteria.true: Intermittent, state-dependent, environment-specific, no error text, or the behaviour contradicts what the code says should happen
criteria.false: An explicit error with a stack trace, a named file with a visible defect, or a static surface whose cause is readable in the source

criteria.browser: A user-visible behaviour, layout, interaction or hydration issue
criteria.failing_test: Deterministic logic with a known input, worth keeping as a regression
criteria.http_call: A contract question. Status, payload shape, auth
criteria.logs_or_trace: It already happened in production, so read Sentry, logs or a trace
criteria.data_snapshot: It depends on specific production data
criteria.not_locally: It cannot be reproduced here, so read the code and instrument instead

evidence.instructions: What artifact would prove the fix worked? Choose the cheapest one that covers the change.

criteria.type_check: Types, a rename, or a signature changed, and nothing runtime did
criteria.unit_test: Pure logic changed and a test can assert the literal result
criteria.browser_screenshot: A visible surface changed and one frame shows it
criteria.recording: A sequence or timing changed and one frame cannot show it
criteria.production_check: The fix is only confirmable against production
criteria.none: Nothing exercised by a check changed
